# Sunrun and Tesla deliver record 580MW to California grid amid heatwave

sunrun vpp puerto rico hurricane maria

Residential battery energy storage systems (BESS) across California discharged more than 580MW of peak power to the state’s grid on the evening of 9 September 2026 via a Tesla-Sunrun VPP.

The event marked the largest virtual power plant (VPP) dispatch event on record with sufficient capacity to power all households in Sacramento County during peak hours.
